description: Returns the Moon's phase, percent lit, lunar age, distance from Earth and waxing or waning direction right now, at 12:00 UK time on a date, or at a UK clock time on a date. Also returns whether it is a full Moon, the next full and new Moon, and at a UK place that date's moonrise, highest point and moonset, the Moon's height and compass bearing, and whether it is above the horizon after dark. Times are UK time, GMT or BST.

date.description: UK calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD, from 1900 to 2100. Without it and without a time, or with today's date alone, the result describes the Moon right now; any other date alone gives the Moon at 12:00 UK time.

place.description: One of 24 UK places for moonrise, highest point, moonset, height and visibility, such as London, Edinburgh, Cardiff, Belfast, Leeds or Lerwick. London without it.

time.description: UK clock time as HH:MM on a 24-hour clock. The result describes the Moon at that time on the date, or on today's date without one.

name: get_moon
title: Moon on a date
